title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-006: Is BlobSidecarsByRoot deprecated protocol fully disabled after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: The blobSidecarByRootRPCHandler function handles RPC requests for blob sidecars by root. Abstract interpretation reveals that the function validates request size and slot windows but DOES NOT implement epoch-based deprecation logic for post-Fulu protocol disablement. The handler processes requests regardless of epoch, with no conditional logic checking FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS.

state_anomalies_found.description: No epoch-based conditional logic found to disable protocol after deprecation window. The function validateBlobByRootRequest checks slot validity window but not fork-based deprecation.
Property requires consistent deprecation between BlobSidecarsByRoot and BlobSidecarsByRange variants, but no cross-variant consistency mechanism found.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Symbolic execution traces execution paths through the handler. Found path where post-deprecation requests are processed successfully instead of being rejected with appropriate error.
attack_path: Attacker sends BlobSidecarsByRoot request when current_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS
Handler processes request without checking deprecation status
Database queries executed for deprecated protocol
Response sent instead of protocol-level rejection
phase2_symbolic_execution.postconditions: Protocol continues responding to deprecated requests (resource waste)

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Required invariant NOT maintained: Protocol should reject all BlobSidecarsByRoot requests after deprecation window. Current implementation violates this by processing requests regardless of epoch.

bug_bounty_assessment.rationale: Post-transition requests cause minor resource waste but do not compromise security. Inconsistent deprecation between variants could confuse implementations (informational finding).

phase3_invariant_proving.recommended_fix: Add epoch-based deprecation check in validateBlobByRootRequest or handler entry point to return appropriate error when current_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS.

title: Supporting Check: Does beacon-node correctly identify pre-Fulu vs post-Fulu blobs by root during transition period?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: The handler retrieves blobs from database by root without epoch-based filtering during transition period. No logic found to distinguish pre-Fulu vs post-Fulu blobs based on their associated epoch/slot.

state_anomalies_found.description: Database query retrieves blobs by root without checking if blob's epoch is pre/post-Fulu. During transition period, post-Fulu blob requests should be rejected.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Execution trace shows that any valid root in database will be returned regardless of associated epoch. No conditional logic prevents serving post-Fulu blobs during transition.
attack_path: During transition period (FULU_FORK_EPOCH <= current < FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS)
Attacker requests blob root for post-Fulu block
Database returns blob without epoch check
Post-Fulu blob served in violation of transition protocol

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Required invariant VIOLATED: During transition, only pre-Fulu blob roots should be served. Current implementation serves any blob in database regardless of epoch.

bug_bounty_assessment.rationale: Protocol state consistency issue during transition period. Could cause client divergence if some clients correctly reject post-Fulu blobs while Prysm serves them.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: Is KZG commitment verification cryptographically sound against forged data column sidecars?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: VerifyCellKZGProofBatch is a thin wrapper delegating to c-kzg-4844 library. Wrapper performs only type conversion without validating cryptographic soundness properties. Critical Fiat-Shamir challenge computation is opaque.

state_anomalies_found.description: Delegates to ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch without visibility into Fiat-Shamir challenge computation.
No validation that RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN is included in hash.
Crosses trust boundary to C library without verification mechanism.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Cannot symbolically execute into c-kzg-4844 library. Requires review of c-kzg-4844 source or test vectors verifying challenge computation.
phase2_symbolic_execution.notes: External library dependency - requires separate audit of c-kzg-4844

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Cryptographic soundness depends on c-kzg-4844 correctness. Prysm wrapper provides no additional validation layer.

bug_bounty_assessment.rationale: KZG verification soundness is fundamental to DA. However, Prysm implementation correctly delegates to trusted c-kzg-4844 library. Recommend: Add test vectors verifying challenge computation matches spec.

phase3_invariant_proving.recommended_verification: Review c-kzg-4844 implementation of compute_verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_challenge to confirm all required inputs are included in hash.

title: Supporting Check: Does KZG proof batch verification maintain soundness properties of individual verification?

state_anomalies_found.description: Batch verification random linear combination technique implemented in c-kzg-4844, not visible in Prysm code.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Cannot execute into external library. Requires c-kzg-4844 audit or test vectors.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Batch verification soundness is external dependency. Prysm correctly uses standard c-kzg-4844 library.

bug_bounty_assessment.rationale: Batch verification implementation is in c-kzg-4844 library, not Prysm code. Prysm usage is correct. Audit of batch verification belongs to c-kzg-4844 audit scope, not Prysm scope.

phase3_invariant_proving.recommended_verification: Use consensus-spec test vectors for batch verification to validate c-kzg-4844 implementation.
